metadata.description: Skills for research and paper work: getting trustworthy numbers, and turning them into a published paper.

plugins.name: training-models
plugins.description: Staged setup and silent-failure diagnosis for neural network training: the loss will not fall, accuracy stalls, gradients blow up, train and eval disagree.

plugins.name: comparing-runs
plugins.description: Turn several finished runs into one table that survives review: comparable ablation arms, baseline reproduction, seeds and error bars, a row you can trace back to its commit.

plugins.name: writing-papers
plugins.description: Draft, review, and polish the prose of a technical paper around one evidence-backed contribution.

plugins.name: drawing-figures
plugins.description: Plan and produce publication-grade figures: budgets derived from a reference corpus, charts, diagrams, qualitative panels, and print-ready exports.

plugins.name: publishing-papers
plugins.description: Everything after the science is settled: the journal's manuscript source and local build, the upload packet, and the point-by-point response to reviewers.
